server_name.description: The server name reported in HTTP headers and logs.

server_ident.description: Server identification string (e.g., product name and version) shown in the Server header.

server_admin.description: Email address of the server administrator, used in error pages and headers.

server_ip.description: IP address the server binds to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' or a specific interface IP). Use '*' for all interfaces.

server_port.description: TCP port on which the ICAP server listens for incoming connections.

timeout.description: Maximum idle time (seconds) before closing a connection.

connect_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for establishing a connection to a remote service or peer.

connect_retry_interval.description: Time (seconds) to wait before retrying a failed connection to a remote service.

max_keepalive_requests.description: Maximum number of requests allowed over a single persistent (keep-alive) connection.

keepalive_timeout.description: Time (seconds) to keep a keep-alive connection open before closing.

log_dir.description: Directory where log files are stored.

debug_level.description: Debug verbosity level (0=none, 10=max); typically 0 in production.

log_level.description: Minimum severity level for logging messages: 'emerg', 'alert', 'crit', 'error', 'warn', 'notice', 'info', 'debug'.

pid_file.description: Full path to the PID file used to track the main server process.

threads_per_child.description: Number of worker threads created per server process.

max_servers.description: Maximum number of server processes to spawn.

min_spare_threads.description: Minimum number of idle threads to maintain across all processes.

max_spare_threads.description: Maximum number of idle threads allowed before killing extra threads.

max_requests_per_child.description: Maximum number of requests a worker thread will serve before terminating and being replaced.

access_control_list.description: Default access control policy: 'deny all' or 'allow all' or custom ACL references.

path.description: Full path to the shared object (.so) file.

modules.description: List of modules to load at startup (e.g., antivirus, content scanning).

name.description: Unique service name (must match service directives in ACLs/rules).

module.description: Name of the module providing the service (must match a loaded module).

options.description: Key-value config options specific to this service.

services.description: List of ICAP services to register (e.g., clamav, dummy).

value.description: Header value (supports macros like '%a' for client IP).

request_headers.description: Custom HTTP request headers to inject into requests sent to ICAP services.

name.description: HTTP header name to add to responses.

value.description: Header value (supports macros and static strings).

response_headers.description: Custom HTTP response headers to inject into client responses.

name.description: ACL name used in service rules (e.g., 'localnet').

acls.description: Access control lists for use in service routing and security rules.

service_name.description: Name of the ICAP service to route to (if action is 'service').

rules.description: Service routing rules: map traffic to ICAP services based on conditions.

enable_safe_mode.description: If enabled, runs the server in a restricted mode (e.g., no unsafe features, stricter permissions).

enable_chroot.description: If enabled, the server drops into a chroot jail at startup for security isolation.

chroot_dir.description: Directory to use as the chroot jail if chroot is enabled.
